limitations: Retrospective scenario only: schedules are reconstructed after the fact; their availability at cutoff is assumed, not verified.
Only BTS reporting carriers are represented; these are not complete airport arrival inputs.
Scheduled gate arrivals include cancellations; observed counts represent runway arrivals. Their difference is an aggregate imbalance proxy, not identified waiting aircraft.
Backlog starts at an explicitly assumed zero at the warmup boundary; earlier backlog, early arrivals, diversions and cancellations are not reconstructed.
Completed-hour observations are assumed immediately available for this replay; historical publication latency is unknown.
No current/future actual arrivals or post-cutoff cancellation labels are used. No flight rescheduling or operational metering is supported.
Model-estimated capacity for reporting carriers, not independently validated facility AAR.
Scenario inputs are not eligible for the verified operational arrival queue.
No delay savings, metering rate, rescheduling or intervention benefit is established.
The caller must verify publication hashes before supplying this dataframe.
The +3h forecast rate is assumed constant across all 6 hours; these are scenario rates, not forecasts at unscored horizons. No rate interpolation is performed.
Queue counts describe this assumed scenario, not identified aircraft, measured delay, savings, or a tested intervention.
